blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Immigration (BI) has intercepted a foreign passenger at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (Naia) for attempting to use another person’s passport and visa to travel to Canada. In a statement on Tuesday, the BI said the “impostor passenger” arrived from Malaysia on Nov. 7 via a Philippine Airlines flight and attempted to board a flight to Canada at Naia Terminal 1 on the same day.
